subject: DPA & data retention questions — MAP + evidence timeline
messages:
From: Roberto Salazar <r.salazar@acmefin.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@acmefin.com
Date: 2027-10-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: DPA and data retention questions for Redwood trial

Hi Tessa,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — the team was impressed with the latency numbers. Before we kick off the pilot, our security/compliance team asked us to collect some concrete answers so we can close the legal loop quickly. I attached a short spreadsheet with our DPA questionnaire and a couple of retention scenarios (Acme stores account data for 7 years for audit purposes — we need to understand Redwood's retention/housekeeping model).

High-level asks:
- Do you have a current SOC 2 report we can share (or a gap summary)?
- SIG/CAIQ posture for hosted API (we asked for the CAIQ Excel in the attached)
- Data residency and retention semantics (can we set per-customer retention periods?)
- DPA redline path: who at Redwood will engage on the DPA?
- Key management/encryption: how are customer keys handled for Dedicated/Private deployments?

Can we get a MAP (mutual action plan) that lays out evidence delivery dates and a target signature date? We’re aiming for a pilot contract signed by 2027-10-20 to hit audit windows downstream.

I attached the questionnaire (Acme_DPA_Questions.xlsx). Happy to hop on a call.

Thanks,
Roberto
Head of Security Engineering
Acme Financial

Attachment: Acme_DPA_Questions.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Roberto Salazar <r.salazar@acmefin.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-10-03T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: DPA and data retention questions for Redwood trial

Roberto — thanks for sending this over and for the candid asks. Appreciate the target date.

Quick answer summary up front:
- SOC 2: we have a SOC 2 Type II report (controls in place through 2027-08). I attached a one-page summary; full report available under NDA.
- SIG/CAIQ: we maintain a CAIQ extract for our hosted API and a deployment-specific sheet for Dedicated/Private.
- Retention: hosted API is configurable by customer; default is 30 days for non-prod logs, 365 days for customer artifacts, but we can configure per-contract retention windows (including 7-year retention via dedicated export/archive flow).
- DPA path: I own pilot & commercial MAPs for this account — our legal team will do the DPA redline once we agree on the terms (I’ll route to Legal: contracting@redwood.ai).
- Keys: Hosted uses Redwood-managed KMS by default; Dedicated/Private supports customer KMS integrations (Cloud KMS/HSM).

I attached a MAP template (MAP_template_v2.xlsx) with a proposed evidence timeline. Proposed target signature date: 2027-10-19 to give both teams time for redline & SOW. Can you confirm if that target works for Acme?

If helpful, we can run a 30-minute MAP review tomorrow at 11am PT.

Thanks — Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Enterprise Sales – Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0187

Attachment: MAP_template_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Date: 2027-10-04T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: DPA and data retention questions for Redwood trial

Looping in the infra/compliance notes for the MAP:

Neha and I sketched a proposed evidence cadence:
- Day 1 (2027-10-05): SOC 2 summary + CAIQ extract + encryption architecture diagram (redwood_soc2_summary.pdf attached).
- Day 3 (2027-10-07): Demo of key management options (hosted vs customer KMS) + small technical Q&A (30 mins).
- Day 5 (2027-10-09): Delivery of DPA redline sample (we’ll provide a starter doc to speed contracting).
- Day 10 (2027-10-14): Final legal redline window/decision deadline.

We can support a 7-year retention pattern via: archived exports to customer-controlled storage on Dedicated or a managed long-term archival flow for hosted customers (exports are encrypted in transit & at rest). We should confirm SLA/availability tradeoffs for archive restores in the MAP — that’s often the sticking point.

Neha, can you add a short note on evidence packaging (reports, screenshots, signed attestations) for the MAP template?

-Karthik
Sr. Product Manager, Security & Privacy
Redwood Inference

Cc: security@acmefin.com
Date: 2027-10-04T13:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: DPA and data retention questions for Redwood trial

Thanks, Tessa — that cadence looks reasonable. A couple clarifications from our side: 

- 7-year retention: we need a documented restoration SLA for archives (RTO within 72 hours max). Can Redwood commit to an export/restore SLA for archived records?
- DPA redline: wed like to receive a starter redline by 2027-10-09. Will you provide a markup we can circulate internally?
- Evidence: for SOC 2 we require signed management assertions + scope page; if the full report requires NDA thats fine but we need the date ranges and auditor name in the MAP.

We are good for the MAP review call on 2027-10-05 11am PT — Roberto, Ill send a calendar invite.

Roberto

Thanks for the call earlier — good alignment. Per action items:

1) Evidence packet (by 2027-10-05 EOD): SOC 2 summary (date range + auditor), CAIQ extract, encryption diagram (we delivered these to the shared Drive folder).
2) Starter DPA redline (by 2027-10-09): Legal will upload a redline sample (DPA_redline_sample.docx) to the Drive and send to your counsel.
3) Archive restore SLA proposal: we can commit to RTO 72 hours for restores from encrypted archives; well include recovery runbook language in the MAP.
4) Signature path: propose an internal review window for Acme by 2027-10-16 and final signature target 2027-10-19.

Attachments uploaded to: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cAcme-DPA-evidence (redwood_soc2_summary.pdf, CAIQ_extract.xlsx, encryption_architecture.png).

Next steps for us: contracting@redwood.ai will post the starter DPA redline on 2027-10-09; Karthik/Neha will provide the technical evidence set by EOD 2027-10-05. I will update HubSpot deal HS-45278 with the MAP milestones.

Thanks — Tessa
